descriptions.zh:
理解用户意图，获取对应频道下热点列表，比如“播报体育新闻”。历史接口，建议走“播报单（热榜）问答接口 RunHotTopicChat”，完全覆盖了当前接口的能力。

欢迎前往[控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast)体验。

通过SDK方式调用API可参考控制台“API”下的java、python示例。
descriptions.en:
Understand user intent and retrieve the hot spot list under the corresponding channel, such as “broadcast sports news.” This is a legacy API. We recommend using the “RunHotTopicChat” API for single hot topic Q&A, which fully overwrites the capabilities of this API.  

You can try it out in the [console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/news-broadcast).  

For invoking the API via software development kit (SDK), refer to the Java and Python samples under “API” in the console.
